ImageId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one image.

ImageRecord.description:
One image, stored beside the event it arrived with.

`relative_path` is relative to the configured state directory, so that the
store stays portable. Materializing an image resolves that to an absolute
path; nothing in this system renders image bytes into JSON.

content_type.description: The content type it was served as.

id.description: This image's identifier, minted by the store.

relative_path.description: Where it lives, relative to the configured state directory.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.

source_url.description: Where it was fetched from, when it was fetched from somewhere.

PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.
PrintId.title: PrintId

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
What an image read answers.

The path is absolute on this server's own filesystem, and is the whole of
the answer about the bytes: nothing here renders them, encodes them or
serves them. It is absent when the record is intact and the file is not,
which is a different answer from there being no such image.

path.description: Where its bytes are, absolute on this host.

title: ImageAnswer
